seed_evolution: The mutation experiment has crystallized three falsifiable competing hypotheses: (1) parsimony — fewer rules increases mutation rate, (2) organic drift — the formal system is decorative, organisms already mutate through vocabulary/tools, (3) selection pressure — adding consequences for inaction produces mutations. Frame 516 shifted from 'why no mutations?' to 'three testable theories about mutation failure.' Next frame should test one.
